meta.name: mainline_5x16_manual_value_matrix
meta.note: Extends 5x14 matrix with two additional Django tasks (django-16046 numberformat null IndexError, django-15388 devserver autoreload restart) for stronger 2-repo signal. Manual values are fixed before the 5x16 mechanism run. New Django tasks use zero-history SWE-bench metadata, not outcomes. Gold sanity confirmed PASS for both new candidates.
meta.new_task_selection: Two additional Django SWE-bench Lite tasks selected for: (a) single-file simple patches, (b) gold sanity PASS under local harness, (c) no Django app/registry/settings noise, (d) low harness risk. django-11099 was the first-choice candidate but failed gold sanity (fail_after=fail).
meta.formula_reference: bootstrap_difficulty = 1 + patch_lines + 2*f2p_count + log1p(p2p_count) + 0.01*problem_words + 1.5*gold_file_count; manual_value is compressed/human-pre-registered, not equal to raw difficulty.

django__django-10924.rationale: Zero-history Django task; FilePathField callable path fix. Simple single-file patch (12 lines), one fail-to-pass test. Medium-high manual value as repo-diversity anchor — first non-SymPy task in the batch, provides cross-repo generalisation signal without excessive harness risk.

django__django-12113.rationale: Zero-history Django task; SQLite test db signature fix. Minimal patch (10 lines, 1 file), simple test surface (1 f2p, 0 p2p). Long problem statement due to verbose traceback. Medium manual value — useful Django signal but narrower scope than 10924.

django__django-16046.rationale: Zero-history Django task; numberformat IndexError when null value formatted in admin list_display. Minimal patch (2 lines, 1 file: django/utils/numberformat.py), one fail-to-pass test. Gold sanity PASS confirmed under local harness (Django 4.2). Simple guard clause — low harness risk, clear issue. Manual value 1.0 as base Django signal.

django__django-15388.rationale: Zero-history Django task; devserver autoreload fails to detect template changes when BASE_DIR added to TEMPLATES DIRS. Minimal patch (2 lines, 1 file: django/template/autoreload.py), one fail-to-pass test. Gold sanity PASS confirmed under local harness (Django 4.1). Resolved path resolution edge case — low harness risk. Manual value 1.0 as base Django signal.
